name: library-scrollbar-drag
description: The Electronic Library's scrollbar dragged by a REAL mouse (the bridge has no press-drag-release). The list shows the client's own blueprints, so first copy 14 or more .bcnbt files into versions/<node>/run-smoke/snapshots-client (the node's run-gameTestServer/snapshots-server has dozens). The scenario opens the Library and waits 45 s while a person or a desktop-control agent holds LEFT on the scrollbar's thumb (the strip at the list's right edge), drags it to the bottom and releases. Expected: the list scrolls with the thumb and stays there after the release. Worth running on 26.3, where SDL renumbered the mouse buttons.

steps.name: lib-before
steps.look: the blueprint list at its top, the scrollbar thumb at the top of its strip

steps.label: REAL MOUSE NOW: hold LEFT on the scrollbar thumb, drag it to the bottom, release

steps.name: lib-after
steps.look: the list scrolled to its end (later rows showing) and the thumb at the bottom of its strip
